method.busy: 100*(user+nice+system+irq+softirq+steal)/sum(first 8 /proc/stat fields); excludes idle and iowait; guest not double-counted
method.worker_cpu: delta thread (utime+stime)/HZ/wall_seconds; all matching shard comm names combined

method.profile_category_note: Resolved-symbol self cycles fractions within each worker, not inclusive stacks or directly measured useful-work fractions. driver_control includes useful as well as idle work; unresolved symbols retained separately.
